answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the karst log shows the live set and the summit audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 858 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 38 aliases alive hence means 38 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the velvet quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 14 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
